lines.say: Feeling crushed by what you're carrying right now?
Allah already answered this, before you even asked.
In Surah Ash-Sharh, He says: For indeed, with hardship comes ease.
Then He says it again. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
Ibn Kathir explains: Allah tells us this, then repeats it to make it certain.
And notice the word. Not after hardship. With it.
So hold on. Keep making dua. Your ease is promised.
Share this with someone who needs it today.
lines.cap: Share this with someone who needs it today 🤍

v5.tr: “For indeed, with hardship will be ease.”

endcard: Follow for one authentic reminder every day
